obligations.title: First Aid certificate for clinical staff
obligations.quote: Clinical staff must hold a current First Aid certificate.

obligations.title: Annual AML training
obligations.quote: Treasury staff must complete AML training annually.

obligations.title: Annual security awareness training
obligations.quote: All staff must complete security awareness training each year.

obligations.title: Blocked from tasks without a valid certificate
obligations.quote: A person whose required certificate is missing or expired may not perform the tasks that depend on it until a valid certificate is on file.

obligations.title: Renew certificates 30 days ahead
obligations.quote: Staff must renew each certificate at least 30 days before it expires.

obligations.title: Monthly expiry reporting
obligations.quote: Certification expiry dates must be reported to managers each month.

obligations.title: Training records retention
obligations.quote: Training records must be kept for three years after a person leaves the firm.
